protocol.prefilter: Resize full decoded photograph to ceil(width*scale), ceil(height*scale), then apply the original continuous centered letterbox transform. Canvas high-quality resampling in both passes.
protocol.geometry: Whole photograph; scale=256/max(width,height), centered padding. No annotation, template or fitted error enters preprocessing.
protocol.comparison: The same held-out model and actual WASM session processes the archived Python RGB and browser-resized full photograph. Pin source and input identities; record pixel and probability differences.
protocol.scope: Sixteen development photographs stored as full-size lossless PNGs, reused in place. Original JPEG/EXIF decoding and UI integration remain outside this experiment.
protocol.gate: Exact reference replay is required before interpreting changes; probability/classification differences from preprocessing are measurements, not tolerated silently. Compare resulting supported crops and derived RGB masks before any release decision.

releaseStatus: Diagnostic only; no website integration or deployment.
